subject: PO staging and surge cap allocation for IronForge onboarding
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@ironforge.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@ironforge.com
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: IronForge onboarding — PO request + line item clarification

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for walking us through the Dedicated plan yesterday. We are ready to proceed with procurement but have two asks before we kick off:

1) Can Redwood issue a provisional PO number we can reference on our internal ticketing while procurement completes vendor setup? We usually need something to attach to the proforma.
2) We attached our proforma (IF-proforma-lineitems.xlsx) — it contains three line items with different SKUs and an initial surge-cap estimate. Your portal currently shows a single bundled SKU and a spend cap that looks lower than expected. Can someone confirm the mapping so our AP team can match invoices?

Attached: ironforge_onboarding_form_v3.pdf, IF-proforma-lineitems.xlsx

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Vendor Ops Lead
IronForge Systems
procure@ironforge.com

From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@ironforge.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IronForge onboarding — PO request + line item clarification

Marta —

Appreciate the form and the proforma. Quick answers and next steps:

- I can provision a draft PO identifier for your AP to reference: PO-2026-IF-001 (DRAFT). This is provisional and will be finalized once procurement confirms legal/terms.
- I noticed the SKU mapping mismatch you mentioned. Our onboarding catalog currently maps your three proforma SKUs to our single Dedicated:small SKU in the portal; that compresses the line items and explains the lower cap. We should keep the vendor-facing line items 1:1 so invoices align with your internal ledger.

Ben / Laura — can you confirm if we can create a staged PO with the three explicit line items (as in IF-proforma-lineitems.xlsx) and set a temporary surge cap of $45k for month 1 to cover onboarding bursts? If legal needs to sign a formal amendment we can mark this PO as provisional until the contract is countersigned.

Marta — attaching the onboarding form back with a small redline and the provisional PO draft.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: PO-2026-IF-001-draft.pdf

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IronForge onboarding — PO request + line item clarification

Tessa / Laura —

I reviewed IF-proforma-lineitems.xlsx and the portal SKU mapping. We're good to create the staged PO with explicit line items. Notes:
- Line 1 (Dedicated:small - baseline): $12,000/mo
- Line 2 (Burst capacity / surge): $25,000 one-time cap for month 1 (we'll flag this as surge-cap and set an expiration date)
- Line 3 (Premium support add-on): $3,500/mo

Action items for ops:
1) Create PO-2026-IF-001 (Staged) with the three line items and mark surge-cap = $25,000 expiring 2026-10-31.
2) Add a note in the PO metadata: "Provisional until Legal countersign; invoices accepted against staged PO with reference to final PO when issued."
3) Ensure line-item tags (SKU ids) are exported in the PO PDF for vendor AP mapping.

I'll take step 1 and circulate the PDF once generated.

-Ben

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Marta Ruiz <marta@ironforge.com>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IronForge onboarding — PO request + line item clarification

Marta —

Attached is PO-2026-IF-001 (Staged) — it includes the three explicit line items and the surge cap flagged as a one-time month-1 buffer of $25,000. Connor, can you please confirm the SKU ids are the ones exported to accounting (Connor: see Supplier Catalog export token SUP-IF-998)?

Marta, please confirm on your side if the line descriptions map to your proforma rows; if we need any textual tweaks (part numbers or cost centers) we can update and re-issue before Legal finalizes. Once you confirm, Ben / I will move the PO from staged -> active provisioning.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Vendor Enablement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: PO-2026-IF-001-draft.pdf

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@ironforge.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@ironforge.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IronForge onboarding — PO request + line item clarification

Laura / Tessa —

Thanks — confirmed. The three line items map cleanly to our proforma after a quick crosswalk; SKU ids in the PO PDF match our AP fields. We accept the staged PO-2026-IF-001 (Staged) and will attach it to our internal PO ticket. We'll submit invoices against it for the month-1 surge and include the staged PO id in the reference field.

Please send the final active PO once Legal completes countersign — we expect that by 10/05/2026.

One small correction request: can the surge-cap one-line description explicitly read "Month‑1 surge cap (expires 2026-10-31)"? That helps our AP automation. If you can re-issue the PO PDF with that minor wording tweak, we'll finalize and start billing.

Regards,
Marta Ruiz
Vendor Ops Lead
IronForge Systems
